import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_15/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_15/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on movieId
df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Process genres column to create genres_arr (list of genres as string) and genre_count (first genre)
df['genres_arr'] = df['genres'].str.split('|').apply(lambda x: str(x))
df['genre_count'] = df['genres'].str.split('|').str[0]

# Ensure column types match target schema
df = df.astype({
    'userId': 'int64',
    'movieId': 'int64',
    'rating': 'float64',
    'timestamp': 'int64',
    'title': 'string',
    'genres': 'string',
    'genres_arr': 'string',
    'genre_count': 'string'
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema
df = df[['userId', 'movieId', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'title', 'genres', 'genres_arr', 'genre_count']]

# Write to target path without index
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on movieId (inner join to keep only matching movieIds)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Process genres to create genres_arr and genre_count columns
# genres_arr: list of genres split by '|'
# genre_count: first genre in the genres list (string)

joined["genres_arr"] = joined["genres"].str.split("|")
joined["genre_count"] = joined["genres_arr"].str[0]

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
final = joined[["userId", "movieId", "rating", "timestamp", "title", "genres", "genres_arr", "genre_count"]]

# Write to target file
final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
